issuer: Texas Committee on Professional Ethics (State Bar of Texas)
title: Texas Ethics Opinion 7
text:
Opinion 7
April 1947
Question Presented
The propriety of listing of attorneys in a regular column in a newspaper headed "Legal Directory."
18 Baylor L. Rev. 197 (1966)
SOLICITATION - PROFESSIONAL LISTING - NEWSPAPERS
A professional listing in a regular column in a newspaper headed "Legal Directory," is proper. (This opinion has been overruled to the extent that it conflicts with Opinion 68.)
Canons 24, 39.
Such a listing is not improper where same contains only the statements expressly set out in Canon 39.
Bluebook Citation
Tex. Comm. On Professional Ethics, Op. 7 (1947)
